2	## Jelly Hop: Fork From Above. Session state machine, level building, checkpoints and flow.
3	## Based on the walker-jumpman starter's session (same pattern: one Node2D that builds the
4	## level in code, real Area2D overlaps for hazards, contact settling after a teleport).
5	
6	const Player = preload("res://features/player/player.gd")
7	const Hud = preload("res://ui/hud.gd")
8	const Fork = preload("res://features/fork/fork.gd")
9	const SoundEvents = preload("res://audio/sound_events.gd")
10	const MusicController = preload("res://audio/music_controller.gd")
11	const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
12	enum State { INTRO, PLAYING, PAUSED, SPLAT, REFORM, WON }
13	const ART := "res://assets/art/"
14	
15	var state: State = State.INTRO
16	var player: CharacterBody2D
17	var camera: Camera2D
18	var hud: Control
19	var plates: Array[Dictionary] = []   # {index, left, center, body}
20	var sauce_areas: Array[Area2D] = []
21	var forks: Array = []                # one entry per plate: a fork node or null
22	var goal: Area2D
23	var checkpoint: int = 0
24	var jelly_plate: int = 0   # the plate the jelly stands on, or the last plate it stood on (airborne or on bare table)
25	var splats: int = 0
26	var splat_cause: String = ""
27	var timer: float = 0.0
28	var test_mode: bool = false
29	var contact_settle_ticks: int = 0
30	var intro_ticks: int = 0
31	var shake_ticks: int = 0
32	var shake_rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
33	var win_from: Vector2
34	var prompt_shown: bool = false
35	var won_once: bool = false   # SFX-WIN plays once per run
36	var sound: Node
37	var music: Node

39	func _ready() -> void:
40		process_physics_priority = 10
41		_setup_input()
42		sound = SoundEvents.new()
43		sound.context = func() -> String: return State.keys()[state]
44		add_child(sound)
45		music = MusicController.new()
46		add_child(music)
47		_build_level()
48		player = Player.new()
49		player.sound = sound
50		add_child(player)
51		player.reset_at(spawn_point(0))
52		camera = Camera2D.new()
53		camera.position_smoothing_speed = T.CAMERA_SMOOTHING
54		camera.process_callback = Camera2D.CAMERA2D_PROCESS_PHYSICS   # moves in physics ticks (deterministic)
55		add_child(camera)
56		shake_rng.seed = 7270
57		var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
58		add_child(layer)
59		hud = Hud.new()
60		hud.game = self
61		layer.add_child(hud)
62		get_window().focus_exited.connect(_on_focus_lost)
63		add_child(preload("res://effects/effects_driver.gd").new())
64		_start_intro()

66	func _setup_input() -> void:
67		# SLICE-BRIEF.md §6 (decided 2026-10-02).
68		var actions := {"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT], "move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT], "jump": [KEY_SPACE, KEY_UP, KEY_W], "pause": [KEY_ESCAPE], "mute_all": [KEY_M], "mute_music": [KEY_N]}
69		for action in actions:
70			if InputMap.has_action(action):
71				continue
72			InputMap.add_action(action)
73			for key in actions[action]:
74				var event := InputEventKey.new()
75				event.physical_keycode = key
76				InputMap.action_add_event(action, event)
77	
78	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- level
79	
80	func _sprite(file: String, scale_factor: float) -> Sprite2D:
81		var sprite := Sprite2D.new()
82		sprite.texture = load(ART + file)
83		sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * scale_factor
84		sprite.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
85		return sprite
86	
87	func _build_level() -> void:
88		var width := T.level_width()
89		# Room: static, behind everything, fixed to the screen (no parallax unless approved).
90		var room_layer := CanvasLayer.new()
91		room_layer.layer = -10
92		add_child(room_layer)
93		var room := _sprite("ENV-ROOM.png", 1.0)
94		room.centered = false
95		room.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR
96		room_layer.add_child(room)
97		# Table front: repeats every 1376 * 0.3378 = 465 px; its top edge is the table top.
98		var step := 1376.0 * T.TABLE_SCALE
99		var x := -step
100		while x < width + step:
101			var table := _sprite("ENV-TABLE.png", T.TABLE_SCALE)
102			table.centered = false
103			table.position = Vector2(x, T.TABLE_TOP)
104			table.z_index = -5
105			add_child(table)
106			x += step
107		_add_solid(Rect2(-64, T.TABLE_TOP, width + 128, 200))   # table top: the floor
108		_add_solid(Rect2(-64, -400, 64, 1120))                  # left end wall
109		_add_solid(Rect2(width, -400, 64, 1120))                # right end wall
110		# Plates: sprite plus a solid box whose top is the landing surface.
111		var lefts := T.plate_lefts()
112		var land_y := T.plate_landing_y()
113		var half := T.plate_landing_half_width()
114		for i in range(lefts.size()):
115			var center: float = lefts[i] + T.plate_width() / 2.0
116			var plate := _sprite("ENV-PLATE.png", T.PLATE_SCALE)
117			plate.centered = false
118			plate.offset = Vector2(-T.PLATE_ART_CENTER_X, -T.PLATE_ART_BOTTOM_ROW - 1.0)
119			plate.position = Vector2(center, T.TABLE_TOP)
120			plate.z_index = -2
121			add_child(plate)
122			var body := _add_solid(Rect2(center - half, land_y, half * 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP - land_y))
123			plates.append({"index": i, "left": lefts[i], "center": center, "body": body})
124			# One fork per plate that has one (SLICE-BRIEF.md §5).
125			var cycle = T.FORK_CYCLES[i]
126			if cycle == null:
127				forks.append(null)
128			else:
129				var fork := Fork.new()
130				fork.position = Vector2(center, land_y)
131				add_child(fork)
132				fork.setup(i, cycle)
133				forks.append(fork)
134		# Sauce in some gaps, centred in the gap, sitting on the table top.
135		for g in range(T.PLATE_GAPS.size()):
136			if not T.SAUCE_IN_GAP[g]:
137				continue
138			var gap_center: float = lefts[g] + T.plate_width() + T.PLATE_GAPS[g] / 2.0
139			var sauce := _sprite("ENV-SAUCE.png", T.SAUCE_SCALE)
140			sauce.centered = false
141			sauce.offset = Vector2(-470.0, -151.0)   # canvas centre x; bottom opaque row 150
142			sauce.position = Vector2(gap_center, T.TABLE_TOP + 2.0)
143			sauce.z_index = -1
144			add_child(sauce)
145			# Hit zone = the visible puddle body (the lower rows, ~119 px wide; the thin top edge is left out).
146			sauce_areas.append(_add_area(Rect2(gap_center - 58.0, T.TABLE_TOP - 12.0, 116.0, 14.0), 8))
147		# Dome at the far end, on the table; drawn in front of the jelly so it sits inside the glass.
148		var dome := _sprite("ENV-DOME.png", T.DOME_SCALE)
149		dome.centered = false
150		dome.offset = Vector2(-375.0, -528.0)
151		dome.position = Vector2(T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP + 1.0)
152		dome.z_index = 5
153		add_child(dome)
154		goal = _add_area(Rect2(T.dome_left() + 40.0, T.TABLE_TOP - 100.0, T.dome_width() - 80.0, 100.0), 16)
155	
156	func _add_solid(rect: Rect2) -> StaticBody2D:
157		var body := StaticBody2D.new()
158		body.position = rect.position + rect.size / 2
159		body.collision_layer = 1
160		body.collision_mask = 2
161		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
162		shape.size = rect.size
163		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
164		collision.shape = shape
165		body.add_child(collision)
166		add_child(body)
167		return body
168	
169	func _add_area(rect: Rect2, layer: int) -> Area2D:
170		var area := Area2D.new()
171		area.position = rect.position
172		area.collision_layer = layer
173		area.collision_mask = 2
174		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
175		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
176		shape.size = rect.size
177		collision.shape = shape
178		collision.position = rect.size / 2.0
179		area.add_child(collision)
180		add_child(area)
181		return area
182	
183	func spawn_point(plate_index: int) -> Vector2:
184		return Vector2(plates[plate_index].center, T.plate_landing_y())
185	
186	func plate_under(x: float) -> int:
187		## Index of the plate whose landing surface is under x, or -1.
188		for p in plates:
189			if absf(x - p.center) <= T.plate_landing_half_width() + 26.0:
190				return p.index
191		return -1
192	
193	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- flow
194	
195	func camera_target_x() -> float:
196		## Follow the jelly to the right and look ahead, so the next forks' shadows are on screen.
197		return clampf(player.position.x + T.LOOK_AHEAD, T.VIEW.x / 2.0, T.level_width() - T.VIEW.x / 2.0)
198	
199	func _set_camera(x: float, smooth: bool) -> void:
200		## Snap the camera to x; smoothing (the glide back on respawn) applies to later moves.
201		camera.position = Vector2(x, T.VIEW.y / 2.0)
202		camera.reset_smoothing()
203		camera.position_smoothing_enabled = smooth
204	
205	func _start_intro() -> void:
206		## Panel 1: eye-level pan from the dome back to the jelly. Movement is locked.
207		state = State.INTRO
208		intro_ticks = 0
209		player.enabled = false
210		music.restart()
211		_set_camera(T.level_width() - T.VIEW.x / 2.0, false)
212	
213	func start_session() -> void:
214		## Begin play on the first plate: when the intro pan ends or is skipped, or on replay after
215		## the dome (no pan). Every fork cycle and the checkpoint reset.
216		if state == State.PLAYING:
217			return
218		if state == State.WON:
219			music.restart()   # replay: the loop starts again from the top
220		splats = 0
221		checkpoint = 0
222		jelly_plate = 0
223		prompt_shown = false
224		won_once = false
225		shake_ticks = 0
226		camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
227		for fork in forks:
228			if fork:
229				fork.reset_cycle()
230		_begin_play(spawn_point(0))
231		_set_camera(camera_target_x(), true)
232	
233	func _begin_play(at: Vector2) -> void:
234		state = State.PLAYING
235		timer = 0.0
236		# Area2D overlaps are physics-step snapshots. Discard pre-teleport contacts
237		# until the broadphase has observed the reset, preventing a phantom second splat.
238		contact_settle_ticks = 2
239		player.reset_at(at)
240		player.enabled = true
241		# Control returns: the checkpoint fork's safe window begins now (panel 6, failure #12).
242		if forks[checkpoint]:
243			forks[checkpoint].restart_at_safe()
244	
245	func set_paused(value: bool) -> void:
246		if value and state == State.PLAYING:
247			state = State.PAUSED
248			player.enabled = false
249		elif not value and state == State.PAUSED:
250			state = State.PLAYING
251			player.enabled = true
252			player.require_fresh_press()
253	
254	func _on_focus_lost() -> void:
255		if not test_mode:
256			set_paused(true)
257	
258	func resolve_contacts(cause: String, finished: bool) -> void:
259		## cause: "" (none), "fork" or "sauce". A failure wins over reaching the goal.
260		if state != State.PLAYING:
261			return
262		if cause != "":
263			state = State.SPLAT
264			splats += 1
265			splat_cause = cause
266			timer = T.SPLAT_TIME
267			player.enabled = false
268			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
269			# One splat sound per failure: hits stay off until control returns.
270			sound.play("SFX-SPLAT-FORK" if cause == "fork" else "SFX-SPLAT-SAUCE")
271			if cause == "fork":
272				shake_ticks = T.ticks(T.SHAKE_TIME)   # camera only; never on a sauce splat
273			# The jelly will re-form on the checkpoint plate: hold that fork raised until control returns.
274			if forks[checkpoint]:
275				forks[checkpoint].hold_raised()
276		elif finished:
277			state = State.WON
278			timer = 0.0
279			prompt_shown = false
280			win_from = player.position
281			player.enabled = false
282			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
283			if not won_once:
284				won_once = true
285				sound.play("SFX-WIN")
286	
287	func view_rect() -> Rect2:
288		return Rect2(camera.get_screen_center_position() - T.VIEW / 2.0, T.VIEW)
289	
290	func shadow_on_screen(fork) -> bool:
291		return view_rect().intersects(fork.shadow_rect())
292	
293	func _advance_forks() -> void:
294		## Forks keep their fixed rhythm during play, splat and re-form (paused, intro and win freeze them).
295		for fork in forks:
296			if fork and fork.advance() == "down":
297				# SFX-WARN (Kiran, 2026-10-03, after the second audition): the scrape plays once when the fork
298				# over the jelly's current or next plate starts descending, if that fork is on screen at that
299				# moment. Nothing plays when a shadow starts growing; the shadow alone does the warning.
300				fork.announced = shadow_on_screen(fork) and fork.plate_index in [jelly_plate, jelly_plate + 1]
301				if fork.announced:
302					on_warning(fork)
303	
304	func on_warning(_fork) -> void:
305		sound.play("SFX-WARN")   # once per strike, as the fork starts descending
306	
307	func warnings_on_screen() -> int:
308		## Forks warning (shadow growing, or striking) with any part of the shadow on screen.
309		## CHANGE-BRIEF.md music rule (Kiran, 2026-10-03): a shadow that started off screen dips
310		## the music once it is on screen, though it never plays SFX-WARN.
311		var n := 0
312		for fork in forks:
313			if fork and fork.is_warning() and shadow_on_screen(fork):
314				n += 1
315		return n
316	
317	func music_target() -> String:
318		match state:
319			State.INTRO:
320				return "intro"
321			State.PAUSED:
322				return "pause"
323			State.WON:
324				return "end_quiet" if prompt_shown else "win_fade"
325			State.SPLAT, State.REFORM:
326				return "splat"
327		return "warning" if warnings_on_screen() > 0 else "normal"
328	
329	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
330		if state in [State.PLAYING, State.SPLAT, State.REFORM]:
331			_advance_forks()
332		match state:
333			State.INTRO:
334				intro_ticks += 1
335				var k := clampf(float(intro_ticks) / float(T.ticks(T.INTRO_PAN)), 0.0, 1.0)
336				var from := T.level_width() - T.VIEW.x / 2.0
337				camera.position.x = lerpf(from, camera_target_x(), ease(k, -2.0))   # ease in-out
338				if k >= 1.0:
339					start_session()
340			State.WON:
341				# Slide into the dome, then wait for the prompt (panel 7).
342				timer += delta
343				var k := clampf(timer / T.WIN_SLIDE, 0.0, 1.0)
344				var dome_center := Vector2(T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP)
345				player.position = win_from.lerp(dome_center, 1.0 - (1.0 - k) * (1.0 - k))
346				if timer >= T.PROMPT_DELAY:
347					prompt_shown = true
348			State.SPLAT:
349				timer -= delta
350				if timer <= 0.0:
351					# Re-form on the last safe plate; hits stay off and input stays locked.
352					state = State.REFORM
353					timer = T.REFORM_TIME
354					player.reset_at(spawn_point(checkpoint))
355					jelly_plate = checkpoint
356			State.REFORM:
357				timer -= delta
358				if timer <= 0.0:
359					_begin_play(spawn_point(checkpoint))
360			State.PLAYING:
361				timer += delta
362				var cause := ""
363				for sauce in sauce_areas:
364					if sauce.overlaps_body(player):
365						cause = "sauce"
366				for fork in forks:
367					if fork and fork.hit_area.overlaps_body(player):
368						cause = "fork"
369				if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
370					contact_settle_ticks -= 1
371				else:
372					resolve_contacts(cause, goal.overlaps_body(player))
373				if state == State.PLAYING and player.just_landed:
374					# Airborne -> grounded, and not into sauce (that is a splat). Respawn is not a landing.
375					sound.play("SFX-LAND")
376					var p := plate_under(player.position.x)
377					if p >= 0:
378						checkpoint = p
379		if state != State.INTRO:
380			camera.position.x = camera_target_x()   # smoothing gives the glide back on respawn
381		if shake_ticks > 0:
382			shake_ticks -= 1
383			var amount := T.SHAKE_PX * float(shake_ticks) / float(T.ticks(T.SHAKE_TIME))
384			camera.offset = Vector2(shake_rng.randf_range(-1, 1), shake_rng.randf_range(-1, 1)) * amount
385		else:
386			camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
387		music.set_target(music_target())
388		var under := plate_under(player.position.x)
389		if under >= 0 and player.is_on_floor() and state == State.PLAYING:
390			jelly_plate = under
391		player.worried = state == State.PLAYING and under >= 0 and forks[under] != null and forks[under].phase() == Fork.Phase.SHADOW
392		player.override_pose = {State.SPLAT: "SPLAT", State.REFORM: "RESPAWN", State.WON: "CELEBRATE"}.get(state, "")
393		if is_instance_valid(hud):
394			hud.queue_redraw()
395	
396	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
397		if not (event is InputEventKey) or event.echo or not event.pressed:
398			return
399		# M and N only toggle mute; muting never changes game state, so they never skip or restart.
400		if event.is_action_pressed("mute_all") or event.is_action_pressed("mute_music"):
401			toggle_mute(event.is_action_pressed("mute_all"))
402			return
403		if state == State.INTRO:
404			start_session()   # any key skips the pan; the skip key never hops (fresh press rule)
405		elif state == State.WON:
406			if prompt_shown:
407				start_session()   # any key plays again, on the first plate, with no intro pan
408		elif event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
409			set_paused(state != State.PAUSED)
410	
411	func toggle_mute(all: bool) -> void:
412		music.toggle_mute(all)

1	extends SceneTree
2	## Effect A state checks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Effect A, rules A1-A8). Loads the real main.tscn and
3	## drives it only with synthetic key events through Godot Input (not human playtesting). The test
4	## reads game state (the jelly's position, the session state, fork 2's rhythm, sound.calls) and never
5	## writes it; the one thing it sets is get_tree().paused, for A8. It never calls the effects driver:
6	## every puff here comes from a landing in the real game loop. Headless, the renderer is a dummy, so
7	## only node state is observed (instances, position, emitting, finished, parent), never crumbs.
8	## A2's WON case is pending: it is checked in Effect B's real-input run to the dome.
9	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
10	const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
11	const PUFF_SCENE := "res://effects/land_puff.tscn"
12	const LIFETIME_TICKS := 24      # land_puff.tscn lifetime 0.40 s at 60 ticks/s
13	const BRIEF_GAP := Vector2i(9, 12)   # brief A4/A5: plate-edge scoot-off, 0.15-0.2 s
14	const RUN_LEFT_TO_X := 170.0    # route: back up on plate 1 for a run-up; stops ~18 px later, still on the plate (edge 135.5)
15	const HOP_FROM_X := 160.0       # route: a running hop from here lands at plate 1's right edge
16	var game: Node2D
17	var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
18	var failures := 0
19	var puffs: Array[Dictionary] = []      # one entry per LandPuff added to the tree
20	var a1_mismatches: Array[Dictionary] = []
21	var max_alive := 0

## Effect A state checks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Effect A, rules A1-A8). Loads the real main.tscn and
## drives it only with synthetic key events through Godot Input (not human playtesting). The test
## reads game state (the jelly's position, the session state, fork 2's rhythm, sound.calls) and never
## writes it; the one thing it sets is get_tree().paused, for A8. It never calls the effects driver:
## every puff here comes from a landing in the real game loop. Headless, the renderer is a dummy, so
## only node state is observed (instances, position, emitting, finished, parent), never crumbs.
## A2's WON case is pending: it is checked in Effect B's real-input run to the dome.
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
const PUFF_SCENE := "res://effects/land_puff.tscn"
const LIFETIME_TICKS := 24      # land_puff.tscn lifetime 0.40 s at 60 ticks/s
const BRIEF_GAP := Vector2i(9, 12)   # brief A4/A5: plate-edge scoot-off, 0.15-0.2 s
const RUN_LEFT_TO_X := 170.0    # route: back up on plate 1 for a run-up; stops ~18 px later, still on the plate (edge 135.5)
const HOP_FROM_X := 160.0       # route: a running hop from here lands at plate 1's right edge
var game: Node2D
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0
var puffs: Array[Dictionary] = []      # one entry per LandPuff added to the tree
var a1_mismatches: Array[Dictionary] = []
var max_alive := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
	call_deferred("run")

func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	if not (node is GPUParticles2D and node.scene_file_path == PUFF_SCENE):
		return
	var entry := {"index": puffs.size(), "node": node, "added_frame": Engine.get_physics_frames(), "seen": false, "finished_frame": -1, "exited_frame": -1}
	puffs.append(entry)
	node.finished.connect(func() -> void: entry.finished_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames())
	node.tree_exiting.connect(func() -> void: entry.exited_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames())

func alive() -> Array:
	var out := []
	for e in puffs:
		if is_instance_valid(e.node) and e.node.is_inside_tree():
			out.append(e.index)
	return out

func land_frames() -> Array:
	var out := []
	for c in game.sound.calls:
		if c.id == "SFX-LAND":
			out.append(c.frame)
	return out

func scan() -> void:
	## After each tick: the driver (priority 20) has run after the session (10) and the jelly (0),
	## and no node has had its _process yet, so a puff spawned this tick shows the driver's values.
	var frame := Engine.get_physics_frames()
	for e in puffs:
		if e.seen:
			continue
		e.seen = true
		e.spawn_frame = frame
		e.position = e.node.global_position
		e.player_position = game.player.global_position
		e.emitting = e.node.emitting
		e.state = Game.State.keys()[game.state]
		e.parent_is_session = e.node.get_parent() == game
		e.parent_is_player = e.node.get_parent() == game.player
		e.alive_at_spawn = alive()
	var spawned := []
	for e in puffs:
		spawned.append(e.spawn_frame)
	var lands := land_frames()
	if spawned != lands:
		a1_mismatches.append({"frame": frame, "puff_frames": spawned, "land_frames": lands})
	max_alive = maxi(max_alive, alive().size())

func tick(n: int = 1) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame
		scan()

func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await tick(2)
	key(code, false)
	await tick(1)

func wait_for_puff(max_ticks: int) -> Dictionary:
	var n := puffs.size()
	for i in range(max_ticks):
		await tick()
		if puffs.size() > n:
			return puffs[n]
	return {}

func wait_fork_harmless(fork, span: int) -> void:
	## Read only: wait until plate 2's fork stays raised for the next `span` ticks.
	for i in range(600):
		var ok := true
		for k in range(span + 1):
			ok = ok and fork.harmless_in(k)
		if ok:
			return
		await tick()

func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	if not passed:
		failures += 1
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))

func delay(e: Dictionary) -> int:
	return e.finished_frame - e.spawn_frame if e.finished_frame >= 0 else -1

func summary(e: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	if e.is_empty():
		return {}
	return {"index": e.index, "spawn_frame": e.spawn_frame, "position": str(e.position), "player_position": str(e.player_position), "emitting_at_spawn": e.emitting, "state": e.state, "finished_frame": e.finished_frame, "finished_after_ticks": delay(e), "exited_frame": e.exited_frame, "alive_at_spawn": e.alive_at_spawn}

func run() -> void:
	var main: Node2D = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	main.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(main)
	game = main
	# ---- A2: scene load and intro (60 ticks of the pan), then the intro skip (a respawn).
	await tick(60)
	check("A2-none-on-load-and-intro", game.state == Game.State.INTRO and puffs.is_empty(), {"state": Game.State.keys()[game.state], "puffs": puffs.size()})
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await tick(10)
	check("A2-none-on-intro-skip-respawn", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and puffs.is_empty(), {"state": Game.State.keys()[game.state], "puffs": puffs.size(), "player": str(game.player.global_position)})

	# ---- Solo hop on plate 1 (no fork): the baseline for when a lone puff's finished fires.
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	var solo := await wait_for_puff(80)
	if solo.is_empty():
		check("A1-solo-hop-puff", false, {"reason": "no puff within 80 ticks of a hop"})
		await finish()
		return
	await tick(LIFETIME_TICKS * 2 + 12)
	check("A1-solo-hop-puff", puffs.size() == 1 and game.sound.count("SFX-LAND") == 1, summary(solo))
	check("A6-solo-finished-and-freed", solo.finished_frame >= 0 and solo.exited_frame >= 0 and alive().is_empty(), summary(solo))

	# ---- A4: two landings inside one lifetime. Back up, run right, hop so the jelly lands at the
	# plate's right edge still running, and keep D held so it scoots off and drops 22 px to the table.
	key(KEY_A, true)
	for i in range(120):
		if game.player.global_position.x <= RUN_LEFT_TO_X:
			break
		await tick()
	key(KEY_A, false)
	await tick(20)

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

func check(id: String, passed: bool, observation: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL", "observed": observation})
	if not passed:
		failures += 1
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))

func fresh() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(game):
		game.queue_free()
		await process_frame
	game = Game.new()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	game.start_session()
	game.player.test_control = true
	await steps(3)

func run() -> void:
	await poses()
	await fork_geometry()
	await respawn_safe_window()
	await held_jump_through_splat()
	await intro_and_skip()
	await shake_rules()
	await look_ahead()
	await win_and_restart()
	await trigger_counts()
	await offscreen_shadow_silent()
	await intro_shadows_and_quiet_start()
	await overlapping_shadows()
	await music_states()
	await mute_changes_nothing()
	await hud_text()
	await audio_wiring()
	await warn_scope()
	var report := {"scope":"Jelly Hop slice checks (scripted input); not human playtesting", "engine":Engine.get_version_info().string,"created_at":Time.get_datetime_string_from_system(true),"results":results,"failures":failures}
	var out := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://../evidence")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(out)
	var file := FileAccess.open(out + "/slice-" + str(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) + ".json", FileAccess.WRITE)
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(report,"  "))
	file.close()
	print("SLICE TESTS: %d checks / %d failures" % [results.size(), failures])
	game.queue_free()
	for i in range(30):
		await process_frame   # let the audio server release stopped playbacks before quitting
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

func box_of(p: CharacterBody2D) -> Vector2:
	return (p.collider.shape as RectangleShape2D).size

func poses() -> void:
	await fresh()
	var p: CharacterBody2D = game.player
	# Resting cube on screen: the IDLE art's opaque height x scale should be about 64 px.
	var used := (p.textures["IDLE"] as Texture2D).get_image().get_used_rect()
	var on_screen := Vector2(used.size) * T.JELLY_SCALE
	check("pose-idle-size-64", absf(on_screen.y - 64.0) <= 3.0 and absf(on_screen.x - 64.0) <= 6.0, {"idle_art_px":str(used.size),"on_screen":str(on_screen)})
	# Bottom of the art is flush with the box bottom (the body's origin).
	var art_bottom: float = (float(used.end.y) - T.JELLY_ANCHOR.y) * T.JELLY_SCALE
	check("pose-bottom-flush", absf(art_bottom) <= 0.5, {"art_bottom_minus_box_bottom_px":art_bottom})
	check("pose-idle", p.pose == "IDLE" and box_of(p) == Vector2(52, 58), {"pose":p.pose,"box":str(box_of(p))})
	await steps(T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY) + 2)
	check("pose-bored-after-delay", p.pose == "BORED" and box_of(p) == Vector2(52, 44), {"pose":p.pose,"box":str(box_of(p)),"delay_s":T.BORED_DELAY})
	p.worried = true
	await steps(1)
	check("pose-worry-overrides-bored", p.pose == "WORRY" and box_of(p) == Vector2(52, 58), {"pose":p.pose,"box":str(box_of(p))})
	p.worried = false
	p.test_axis = 1
	var scoots := {}
	for i in range(20):
		await steps(1)
		scoots[p.pose] = true
	p.test_axis = 0
	check("pose-scoot-loop", scoots.has("SCOOT-A") and scoots.has("SCOOT-B") and box_of(p) == Vector2(52, 58), {"seen":scoots.keys()})
	await steps(10)
	p.test_axis = -1
	await steps(4)
	p.test_axis = 0
	await steps(10)
	check("pose-flip-keeps-facing", p.sprite.flip_h and p.pose == "IDLE", {"flip_h":p.sprite.flip_h,"pose":p.pose})
	var seq: Array[String] = []
	var boxes: Dictionary = {}
	p.test_jump_pressed = true
	for i in range(70):
		await steps(1)
		if seq.is_empty() or seq.back() != p.pose:
			seq.append(p.pose)
			boxes[p.pose] = str(box_of(p))
	check("pose-hop-sequence", seq.slice(0, 5) == ["ANTIC", "RISE", "FALL", "LAND", "IDLE"], {"sequence":seq,"boxes":boxes})
	check("pose-hop-boxes", boxes.get("ANTIC") == str(Vector2(52, 58)) and boxes.get("RISE") == str(Vector2(52, 58)) and boxes.get("FALL") == str(Vector2(52, 58)) and boxes.get("LAND") == str(Vector2(52, 44)), {"boxes":boxes})
	game.resolve_contacts("sauce", false)
	await steps(2)
	check("pose-splat", p.pose == "SPLAT", {"pose":p.pose})
	await steps(T.ticks(T.SPLAT_TIME) + 1)
	check("pose-respawn", p.pose == "RESPAWN", {"pose":p.pose})
	await steps(T.ticks(T.REFORM_TIME) + 2)
	check("pose-control-returns-idle", p.pose == "IDLE" and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, {"pose":p.pose,"state":game.state})

func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func hold_fork_down(fork) -> void:
	# Fixture: put the fork at the start of its hold (tines on the plate) and freeze it there.
	fork.t = fork.safe_ticks + fork.shadow_ticks + fork.down_ticks
	fork._apply()
	fork.held = true

func overlaps(shape: Shape2D, at: Vector2, mask: int, areas: bool, bodies: bool) -> Array:
	var q := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
	q.shape = shape
	q.transform = Transform2D(0.0, at)
	q.collision_mask = mask
	q.collide_with_areas = areas
	q.collide_with_bodies = bodies
	var hits := []
	for r in game.get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(q, 32):
		hits.append(r.collider)
	return hits

func fork_geometry() -> void:
	await fresh()
	game.player.enabled = false
	var land_y := T.plate_landing_y()
	var half_plate := T.plate_landing_half_width()
	var bands := {}
	var widths := {}
	var tops := {}
	for fork in game.forks:
		if fork == null:
			continue
		hold_fork_down(fork)
	await physics_frame
	for fork in game.forks:
		if fork == null:
			continue
		var center: float = fork.global_position.x
		# Hit polygons in world space: their x range against the visible tines and the plate.
		var lo := INF
		var hi := -INF
		var lowest := -INF
		for poly in fork.hit_area.get_children():
			for p in poly.polygon:
				var g: Vector2 = poly.global_transform * p
				lo = minf(lo, g.x)
				hi = maxf(hi, g.x)
				lowest = maxf(lowest, g.y)
		var visible_lo: float = center + (T.FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.x - 167.5) * fork.scale_factor
		var visible_hi: float = center + (T.FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.y + 1.0 - 167.5) * fork.scale_factor
		widths[fork.plate_index] = {"hit":[snappedf(lo - center, 0.1), snappedf(hi - center, 0.1)], "visible_tines":[snappedf(visible_lo - center, 0.1), snappedf(visible_hi - center, 0.1)], "plate_landing":[-half_plate, half_plate], "tips_y":snappedf(lowest, 0.1), "landing_y":snappedf(land_y, 0.1)}
		# Fork art top must stay above the screen even with the tines down.
		tops[fork.plate_index] = snappedf(fork.sprite.global_position.y - 1258.0 * fork.scale_factor, 0.1)
		# Safe band: every x where the plate holds the jelly up (box overlaps the plate's
		# landing surface) but the box does not overlap the tines. Both boxes, 1 px steps.
		var band := 0
		for size in [Vector2(52, 58), Vector2(52, 44)]:
			var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
			shape.size = size
			var foot := RectangleShape2D.new()
			foot.size = Vector2(size.x, 2.0)
			var x: float = center - half_plate - size.x / 2.0
			while x <= center + half_plate + size.x / 2.0:
				var supported := overlaps(foot, Vector2(x, land_y + 0.5), 1, false, true).has(game.plates[fork.plate_index].body)
				var hit := overlaps(shape, Vector2(x, land_y - size.y / 2.0), 8, true, false).has(fork.hit_area)
				if supported and not hit:
					band += 1
				x += 1.0
		bands[fork.plate_index] = band
	var all_zero := true
	var widths_ok := true
	for i in bands:
		all_zero = all_zero and bands[i] == 0
		var w: Dictionary = widths[i]
		# No wider than the visible tines (1 px tolerance for the 3-row outline sampling),
		# and at least as wide as the plate's landing surface; tips reach the landing surface.
		widths_ok = widths_ok and w.hit[0] >= w.visible_tines[0] - 1.0 and w.hit[1] <= w.visible_tines[1] + 1.0
		widths_ok = widths_ok and w.hit[0] <= -half_plate and w.hit[1] >= half_plate and absf(w.tips_y - land_y) <= 1.0
	check("fork-edge-band-0px", all_zero and bands.size() == 5, {"safe_band_px_per_plate":bands})
	# Negative control: the same band count with plate 2's hit area squeezed to the Batch 2
	# fork size (70 px head) must find a safe band, so the 0 px result above is not vacuous.
	var control_fork = game.forks[1]
	control_fork.hit_area.scale = Vector2(70.0 / T.FORK_TINE_SPAN_PX, 1.0)
	await physics_frame
	var control_band := 0
	var cshape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	cshape.size = Vector2(52, 58)
	var cfoot := RectangleShape2D.new()
	cfoot.size = Vector2(52, 2)
	var cx: float = control_fork.global_position.x - half_plate - 26.0
	while cx <= control_fork.global_position.x + half_plate + 26.0:
		if overlaps(cfoot, Vector2(cx, land_y + 0.5), 1, false, true).has(game.plates[1].body) and not overlaps(cshape, Vector2(cx, land_y - 29.0), 8, true, false).has(control_fork.hit_area):
			control_band += 1
		cx += 1.0
	control_fork.hit_area.scale = Vector2.ONE
	check("fork-edge-band-control-70px", control_band > 0, {"safe_band_px_with_70px_tines":control_band})
	check("fork-hit-equals-tines", widths_ok, {"per_plate":widths})
	var tops_ok := true
	for i in tops:
		tops_ok = tops_ok and tops[i] < 0.0
	check("fork-top-off-screen", tops_ok, {"fork_art_top_y_with_tines_down":tops})

func respawn_safe_window() -> void:
	# §8 #5 / failure #12: a real fork splat on plate 2, then the checkpoint fork must be at
	# the start of its safe window when control returns; other forks keep their rhythm.
	await fresh()
	var fork2 = game.forks[1]
	var land_y := T.plate_landing_y()
	game.player.position = Vector2(game.plates[1].center, land_y - 30)
	await steps(20)
	var cp: int = game.checkpoint
	var ticks := 0
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and ticks < 600:
		await steps(1)
		ticks += 1
	var cause: String = game.splat_cause
	var others_before := {}
	for f in game.forks:
		if f and f != fork2:
			others_before[f.plate_index] = f.t
	var waited := 0
	while game.state != Game.State.PLAYING and waited < 200:
		await steps(1)
		waited += 1
	var others_ok := true
	var drift := {}
	for f in game.forks:
		if f and f != fork2:
			var expected: int = posmod(others_before[f.plate_index] + waited, f.period)
			drift[f.plate_index] = f.t - expected
			others_ok = others_ok and f.t == expected
	check("respawn-checkpoint-fork-safe", cp == 1 and cause == "fork" and fork2.phase() == fork2.Phase.SAFE and fork2.t <= 1 and not fork2.held, {"checkpoint":cp,"cause":cause,"fork_phase":fork2.phase(),"fork_t":fork2.t,"held":fork2.held})
	check("respawn-other-forks-keep-rhythm", others_ok, {"t_minus_expected":drift,"ticks_waited":waited})
	# The safe window then lasts its full length: the jelly is not hit while standing still.
	var stood := 0
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and stood < fork2.safe_ticks:
		await steps(1)
		stood += 1
	check("respawn-safe-window-lasts", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and stood == fork2.safe_ticks, {"stood_ticks":stood,"safe_ticks":fork2.safe_ticks})

func held_jump_through_splat() -> void:
	# §8 #3 / failure #7: real key events. Jump held through the splat and re-form, plus extra
	# presses during the lock: no hop until a fresh press after control returns.
	await fresh()
	game.player.test_control = false
	key(KEY_SPACE, true)
	await steps(2)
	var jumps_before: int = game.player.jumps
	var splat_frame := Engine.get_physics_frames()
	game.resolve_contacts("sauce", false)

	await steps(2)
	key(KEY_W, false)
	await steps(T.ticks(T.SPLAT_TIME) + T.ticks(T.REFORM_TIME))
	var returned: bool = game.state == Game.State.PLAYING
	await steps(30)        # still holding Space after control returns
	var jumps_while_held: int = game.player.jumps
	var hops_while_held: int = hop_sounds_after(splat_frame)
	key(KEY_SPACE, false)
	await steps(3)
	key(KEY_SPACE, true)   # fresh press
	await steps(3)
	key(KEY_SPACE, false)
	await steps(2)
	var hops_sfx_before_fresh: int = hop_sounds_after(splat_frame)
	check("held-jump-through-splat-no-hop", returned and jumps_while_held == 0 and hops_while_held == 0, {"control_returned":returned,"jumps_while_held":jumps_while_held,"sfx_hop_while_held":hops_while_held,"jumps_before_splat":jumps_before})
	check("fresh-press-hops-after-lock", game.player.jumps == 1 and hops_sfx_before_fresh == 1, {"jumps_after_fresh_press":game.player.jumps,"sfx_hop_after_splat":hops_sfx_before_fresh})
	game.player.test_control = true

	# Panel 1: the pan starts at the dome and ends at the jelly; movement is locked.
	await new_intro_game()
	var start_view: Rect2 = game.view_rect()
	var dome_seen := start_view.has_point(Vector2(T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP - 50.0))

	# §8 #2 / failure #6: skip with the jump key held, and with a quick tap; with a direction held.
	for variant in ["space-held", "space-tap", "d-held"]:
		await new_intro_game()
		await steps(10)
		game.player.test_control = false
		var x_before: float = game.player.position.x
		match variant:
			"space-held":
				key(KEY_SPACE, true)
				await steps(30)
				key(KEY_SPACE, false)
			"space-tap":
				key(KEY_SPACE, true)
				key(KEY_SPACE, false)
				await steps(30)
			"d-held":
				key(KEY_D, true)
				await steps(30)
				key(KEY_D, false)
		await steps(5)
		check("skip-key-no-hop-no-move-" + variant, game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.jumps == 0 and game.sound.count("SFX-HOP") == 0 and absf(game.player.position.x - x_before) < 0.01, {"state":game.state,"jumps":game.player.jumps,"sfx_hop":game.sound.count("SFX-HOP"),"dx":game.player.position.x - x_before})
	# M and N never skip the intro.
	await new_intro_game()
	await tap(KEY_M)
	await tap(KEY_N)
	check("mute-keys-do-not-skip", game.state == Game.State.INTRO, {"state":game.state})
	await tap(KEY_M)
	await tap(KEY_N)

func shake_rules() -> void:
	# §8 #6 / failure #13: sauce splat -> no shake; fork splat -> shake; the jelly never moves.
	await fresh()
	var max_sauce := 0.0
	var sauce_moved := false
	game.resolve_contacts("sauce", false)
	var p0: Vector2 = game.player.position
	for i in range(T.ticks(T.SPLAT_TIME) - 1):
		await steps(1)
		max_sauce = maxf(max_sauce, game.camera.offset.length())
		sauce_moved = sauce_moved or game.player.position != p0
	await steps(T.ticks(T.REFORM_TIME) + 4)
	var max_fork := 0.0
	var fork_moved := false
	game.resolve_contacts("fork", false)
	p0 = game.player.position
	var shapes_before := str(game.player.collider.global_position)
	for i in range(T.ticks(T.SPLAT_TIME) - 1):
		await steps(1)
		max_fork = maxf(max_fork, game.camera.offset.length())
		fork_moved = fork_moved or game.player.position != p0
	var shapes_after := str(game.player.collider.global_position)
	check("shake-none-on-sauce-splat", max_sauce == 0.0 and not sauce_moved, {"max_camera_offset":max_sauce,"jelly_moved":sauce_moved})
	check("shake-on-fork-splat-camera-only", max_fork > 0.0 and max_fork <= T.SHAKE_PX * 1.5 and not fork_moved and shapes_before == shapes_after and game.camera.offset == Vector2.ZERO, {"max_camera_offset":max_fork,"jelly_moved":fork_moved,"collider_before":shapes_before,"collider_after":shapes_after,"offset_after":str(game.camera.offset)})

func win_and_restart() -> void:
	# Panel 7: the dome, "SAFE!", the prompt, then any key restarts on plate 1 with no pan.
	await fresh()
	game.player.position = Vector2(T.dome_left() - 30.0, T.TABLE_TOP)
	game.player.test_axis = 1
	var ticks := 0
	while game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and ticks < 120:
		await steps(1)
		ticks += 1
	game.player.test_axis = 0
	var won: bool = game.state == Game.State.WON
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)   # before the prompt: ignored
	var ignored: bool = game.state == Game.State.WON
	await steps(T.ticks(T.PROMPT_DELAY) + 2)
	var dome_center := T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0
	check("win-dome-celebrate-prompt", won and ignored and game.prompt_shown and game.player.pose == "CELEBRATE" and absf(game.player.position.x - dome_center) < 1.0, {"won":won,"early_key_ignored":ignored,"prompt":game.prompt_shown,"pose":game.player.pose,"x":game.player.position.x,"dome_center":dome_center})
	# Disturb state first so the reset is visible: a splat count and a checkpoint.
	game.splats = 3
	game.checkpoint = 4
	game.player.test_control = false
	var restart_frame := Engine.get_physics_frames()
	key(KEY_SPACE, true)
	await steps(30)
	key(KEY_SPACE, false)
	await steps(2)
	var restart_hops := hop_sounds_after(restart_frame)
	# Every fork restarted from its fixed starting point at the same moment (same elapsed ticks).
	var elapsed := {}
	for f in game.forks:
		if f:
			elapsed[posmod(f.t - f.offset_ticks, f.period)] = true
	var forks_reset: bool = elapsed.size() == 1 and int(elapsed.keys()[0]) <= 32
	var at_start: bool = game.player.position.distance_to(game.spawn_point(0)) < 1.0
	check("restart-key-no-hop-first-plate-reset", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.jumps == 0 and restart_hops == 0 and at_start and game.splats == 0 and game.checkpoint == 0 and forks_reset and not game.prompt_shown, {"state":game.state,"jumps":game.player.jumps,"sfx_hop":restart_hops,"at_first_plate":at_start,"splats":game.splats,"checkpoint":game.checkpoint,"forks_reset":forks_reset,"fork_elapsed_ticks":elapsed.keys()})
	game.player.test_control = true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sound and music placeholders

func hop_sounds_after(frame: int) -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.sound.calls:
		if c.id == "SFX-HOP" and c.frame > frame:
			n += 1
	return n

func counts_since(index: int) -> Dictionary:
	var out := {}
	for c in game.sound.calls.slice(index):
		out[c.id] = out.get(c.id, 0) + 1
	return out

func trigger_counts() -> void:
	# §8 #1 / failure #5: each sound fires once per event, from scripted input.
	await fresh()
	hold_all_forks_except([])   # fixture: only the jelly's own sounds in this part
	var p: CharacterBody2D = game.player
	# Rapid hops on plate 1 (no fork): a press every 40 ticks plus extra presses in the air.
	var mark: int = game.sound.calls.size()
	for i in range(5):
		p.test_jump_pressed = true
		await steps(6)
		p.test_jump_pressed = true   # mid-air press: no double jump, no second sound
		await steps(34)
	await steps(20)
	var c := counts_since(mark)
	check("sfx-rapid-hops-once-each", p.jumps == 5 and c.get("SFX-HOP", 0) == 5 and c.get("SFX-LAND", 0) == 5, {"jumps":p.jumps,"counts":c})
	# A held jump: one hop, one landing.
	mark = game.sound.calls.size()
	p.test_jump_pressed = true
	p.test_jump_held = true
	await steps(120)
	p.test_jump_held = false

1	extends RefCounted
2	## Fixed input route through the real level. No position/velocity edits.
3	## Holds right, stops at a jump mark near the right edge of each plate, and hops when the
4	## forks' fixed rhythms allow a safe path onward. The forks are read, never changed.
5	const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
6	const LEAVE := 6     # ticks the jelly is still over the plate it hops from
7	const ARRIVE := 24   # earliest tick it can be over the next plate (conservative)
8	var jump_marks: Array[float] = []
9	var walk_ticks: Array[int] = []   # hop -> stopped at the next plate's mark (estimate + margin)
10	var next_jump: int = 0
11	var hop_at: int = -1              # route tick of the planned hop on the current plate
12	var ticks: int = 0
13	var hops: Array[Dictionary] = []
14	
15	func _init() -> void:
16		for left in T.plate_lefts():
17			jump_marks.append(left + T.plate_width() / 2.0 + T.plate_landing_half_width() - 12.0)
18		for i in range(jump_marks.size() - 1):
19			var pitch := jump_marks[i + 1] - jump_marks[i]
20			walk_ticks.append(37 + int(maxf(0.0, pitch - 190.0) / 5.0) + 14)
21	
22	func step(game: Node2D) -> void:
23		var player: CharacterBody2D = game.player
24		ticks += 1
25		player.test_control = true
26		player.test_jump_held = false
27		if next_jump >= jump_marks.size() or not player.is_on_floor() or player.position.x < jump_marks[next_jump]:
28			player.test_axis = 1.0
29			return
30		player.test_axis = 0.0
31		if hop_at < 0:
32			hop_at = ticks + plan(game.forks, next_jump)
33		if ticks >= hop_at:
34			player.test_axis = 1.0
35			player.test_jump_pressed = true
36			hops.append({"plate": next_jump + 1, "tick": ticks})
37			next_jump += 1
38			hop_at = -1
39	
40	func safe_span(fork, from: int, to: int) -> bool:
41		if fork == null:
42			return true
43		for k in range(from, to + 1):
44			if not fork.harmless_in(k):
45				return false
46		return true
47	
48	func plan(forks: Array, plate: int) -> int:
49		## Breadth-first search over (plate, ticks from now): wait one tick, or hop. Returns the
50		## first hop's delay on the earliest path that reaches the last plate and can leave it.
51		var last := jump_marks.size() - 1
52		var start := Vector2i(plate, 0)
53		var parent := {start: null}
54		var queue: Array[Vector2i] = [start]
55		while not queue.is_empty():
56			var s: Vector2i = queue.pop_front()
57			var j := s.x
58			var d := s.y
59			if d > 60 * 30:
60				continue
61			if j == last and safe_span(forks[j], d, d + LEAVE):
62				return d if plate == last else _first_hop(parent, s, plate)
63			var waits := Vector2i(j, d + 1)
64			if not parent.has(waits) and safe_span(forks[j], d + 1, d + 1):
65				parent[waits] = s
66				queue.append(waits)
67			if j == last:
68				continue
69			var arrive := d + walk_ticks[j]
70			var hops_to := Vector2i(j + 1, arrive)
71			if not parent.has(hops_to) and safe_span(forks[j], d, d + LEAVE) and safe_span(forks[j + 1], d + ARRIVE, arrive + 6):
72				parent[hops_to] = s
73				queue.append(hops_to)
74		return 0
75	
76	func _first_hop(parent: Dictionary, goal: Vector2i, plate: int) -> int:
77		var s = goal
78		var first_hop := 0
79		while parent[s] != null:
80			var prev: Vector2i = parent[s]
81			if prev.x != s.x and prev.x == plate:
82				first_hop = prev.y
83			s = prev
84		return first_hop
85

## coyote and buffer ticks, a held jump never re-jumps); sizes from CHARACTER-SHEET.md.

const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
const POSES := ["IDLE", "BORED", "SCOOT-A", "SCOOT-B", "ANTIC", "RISE", "FALL", "LAND", "WORRY", "SPLAT", "RESPAWN", "CELEBRATE"]
## CHARACTER-SHEET.md gives the crouch, landing squash and bored slump the low box. In this build
## the crouch (ANTIC) is a visual-only pose shown after takeoff, so it keeps the standing box:
## a low box in the air let the jelly rise 14 px higher into a ceiling (starter low-ceiling check).
const LOW_POSES := ["LAND", "BORED"]
const STANDING := Vector2(52, 58)   # CHARACTER-SHEET.md: bottom-aligned, centred
const LOW := Vector2(52, 44)
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var require_axis_release: bool = true   # a direction held through a lock is ignored until released
var ignore_press_through_frame: int = -1
var facing: float = 1.0
var jumps: int = 0
var was_grounded: bool = true
var just_landed: bool = false
var just_hopped: bool = false
var box: Vector2 = STANDING
var collider: CollisionShape2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures: Dictionary = {}
var pose: String = "IDLE"
var override_pose: String = ""   # set by the session: SPLAT, RESPAWN or CELEBRATE
var worried: bool = false        # set by the session: a shadow is growing over this plate
var idle_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var hop_ticks: int = -1          # ticks since takeoff; -1 when the jelly did not hop
var sound: Node                  # the session's sound-event entry point
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1

		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		just_hopped = true
		hop_ticks = 0

		if sound:

	var grounded := is_on_floor()
	if grounded and not was_grounded:
		just_landed = true
		land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS
		hop_ticks = -1
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not grounded and hop_ticks >= 0:
		hop_ticks += 1
	was_grounded = grounded
	_update_pose()

func choose_pose() -> String:
	## CHARACTER-SHEET.md pose table. Worried always overrides bored.
	if override_pose != "":
		return override_pose
	if not was_grounded:
		if hop_ticks >= 0 and hop_ticks <= T.ANTIC_TICKS:
			return "ANTIC"   # visual only: shown at takeoff, no input delay
		return "RISE" if velocity.y < 0.0 else "FALL"
	if land_ticks > 0:
		return "LAND"
	if absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		return "SCOOT-A" if (tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2 == 0 else "SCOOT-B"
	if worried:
		return "WORRY"
	if idle_ticks >= T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY):
		return "BORED"
	return "IDLE"

func _update_pose() -> void:
	pose = choose_pose()
	sprite.texture = textures[pose]
	sprite.flip_h = facing < 0.0   # drawn facing right; keeps the last direction moved
	var wanted := LOW if pose in LOW_POSES else STANDING

		set_box(wanted)
